entities.name: CLI
entities.rationale: Single-user icon labeled CLI at top-left; developer deploying JavaScript/TypeScript code through the Forge CLI. Outside the AWS accounts.

entities.name: Browser
entities.rationale: Multi-user icon at bottom-left (label partly hidden, transcript says browser); end users invoking the deployed app from the browser. Outside the AWS accounts.

entities.name: EC2 (Deployment Web Service)
entities.rationale: EC2 icon at left of middle row labeled EC2; web service receiving deployments from the CLI (transcript says behind ALB, but ALB is not drawn). Located left of the green account boundary line, in the Forge platform account.

entities.name: DynamoDB
entities.rationale: Blue icon at top labeled DYNAMO DB; stores deployment state. In the Forge platform account (left of green line).

entities.name: SQS
entities.rationale: Pink icon in the middle labeled SQS; queues deployment requests to avoid Lambda control-plane rate limits. In the Forge platform account (left of green line).

entities.name: EC2 (Deployment Worker)
entities.rationale: EC2 icon to the right of SQS labeled EC2; back-end service that reads deployment requests from SQS and creates Lambda functions. In the Forge platform account (left of green line).

entities.name: EC2 (Invocation Service)
entities.rationale: EC2 icon in bottom row labeled EC2; internal service that checks permissions, finds the right Lambda and invokes it. In the Forge platform account (left of green line).

entities.name: Lambda
entities.rationale: Orange icon labeled LAMBDA to the right of the green vertical line; runs customer code (in V8 isolates) in a separate, dedicated AWS account, separated from the Forge platform account by the green account boundary line.

visual_connections.description: Blue arrow from the CLI user icon to the left EC2; developer deploys code to the web service.
Blue curved arrow from the left EC2 up to DynamoDB; stores deployment state.
Blue arrow from the left EC2 to SQS; queues the deployment request.
Blue arrow drawn pointing from the right EC2 towards SQS; the worker reads/polls deployment requests from the queue.
Blue curved arrow from the right EC2 across the green account boundary down to Lambda; creates the Lambda function.
Blue arrow from the browser users icon to the bottom EC2; browser calls the internal invocation service.
Blue arrow from the bottom EC2 across the green account boundary to Lambda; invokes the Lambda.
